project_type: Electron desktop app with better-sqlite3, vanilla HTML/CSS/JS
build_system: npm scripts - no build step needed for dev (Electron loads files directly)
test_framework: Jest with in-memory better-sqlite3 databases, tests in tests/services/ and tests/db/
verification_instructions: Run npx jest --no-coverage and confirm all tests pass. For UI changes, verify the HTML/CSS/JS files are syntactically valid and follow existing patterns.
setup_instructions: node_modules already installed. Run npx jest to verify baseline.
environment_constraints: No Electron runtime available for GUI testing. Validate via unit tests and AST/syntax checks. No Docker needed.
contribution_requirements: Arabic-first RTL UI. All user-facing strings in Arabic with English as secondary. Use escapeHtml() for all user data rendered in HTML.
key_patterns: Services in src/services/ export functions taking (db, ...) params. Renderer screens in src/renderer/js/screens/ are objects with render() returning HTML string and attachEvents() for event binding. IPC calls via window.api.* bridge. CSS uses BEM-like classes with design tokens in :root. Tests use beforeEach with in-memory DB + schema + seeds.
directory_structure: Root: main.js (Electron main), preload.js (IPC bridge). src/db/ (schema, seeds, database init). src/services/ (business logic). src/renderer/ (index.html + css/ + js/screens/ + js/components/ + js/utils/). tests/ (Jest test files).
